note: Suggestions for improving the site and decision making. Nothing here is implemented unless you approve it. Choose Approve, Defer or Reject on the Suggestions page. Your choice is saved only in your browser until it is recorded here.

items.title: Resolved-outcome tracker per category
items.why: Shows Yes/No results and settlement values as they happen, so forecasts can be scored.
items.evidence: Gas markets show result 'no' and settlement_value_dollars 0.0000 (verified).

items.title: Trade journal with a fixed category schema before strategies
items.why: Trades need a consistent category, entry price, size, fee and result. Without this, strategy analysis cannot be trusted.
items.evidence: No trade history exists yet (blocked on a demo key).

items.title: Fee-aware profit and loss
items.why: Ranking opportunities without fees overstates returns. The formula is in the published fee schedule.
items.evidence: Fee formula verified on page 1 of 2 of the fee schedule PDF.

items.title: Stale and inconsistent quote warnings
items.why: Flags markets whose last price is outside the current bid/ask, or whose updated_time is old, before a decision is made.
items.evidence: KXBTCMINY markets D2, D3, D4 show these issues.

items.title: Liquidity filter
items.why: Only consider markets with enough contracts at the price you would trade.
items.evidence: Orderbook endpoint verified on one market. Most sampled markets had zero depth.

items.title: Compare demo prices with production prices
items.why: Kalshi warns demo prices may differ from real markets. A read-only comparison tests whether demo data is useful for decisions.
items.evidence: Demo docs warning (opened); production and demo base URLs verified.

items.title: Scheduled snapshot job with a change log
items.why: Keeps the verified table current and shows what changed each day, so the site does not go stale.
items.evidence: Snapshot is a one-time pull dated 2026-11-20.

items.title: Second-level price charts via WebSocket
items.why: The REST candlesticks endpoint has a one-minute minimum. Seconds need the WebSocket feed.

items.title: Backtest on settled markets using historical data
items.why: Tests strategies on outcomes already known, before any demo money is used.
items.evidence: Historical data is documented; not yet pulled.

items.title: Risk controls and manual confirmation before any order
items.why: Trading should not start until limits are set. Each order should show the fee, the position limit and the expected loss.
items.evidence: Position Accountability Level $25,000 per strike per Member (contract terms, opened).

items.title: Narrow each category to a named list of series
items.why: Category-wide lists are very large (Sports runs to hundreds of chunks). A named list keeps the dashboard fast and the review manageable.
items.evidence: Series list size observed through the fetch tool (U2).

items.title: Verify every contract PDF before marking rows verified
items.why: Most reference PDFs are not opened yet. Opening them lets more rows move from unverified to verified.
items.evidence: Opened: AAAGAS, BTCMINMAX, REFERENDUMPASS (page 1), XBANNED. Not opened: the rest (U5, U6).
